description: This file implements a malloc-based memory allocator for a YAML/YAML-like parsing framework. It provides functions for creating, destroying, allocating, freeing, and managing memory tags, as well as dumping memory usage statistics.

methods.name: int fy_malloc_setup(struct fy_allocator * a,const void * data)
methods.description: Initializes the malloc allocator structure, resets memory tags and entries.

methods.name: void fy_malloc_cleanup(struct fy_allocator * a)
methods.description: Frees all allocated memory entries and resets tags for the malloc allocator.

methods.name: struct:fy_allocator * fy_malloc_create(const void * cfg)
methods.description: Creates a new malloc allocator instance.

methods.name: void fy_malloc_destroy(struct fy_allocator * a)
methods.description: Destroys the malloc allocator instance, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: void fy_malloc_dump(struct fy_allocator * a)
methods.description: Dumps statistics of current allocations and entries to stderr.

methods.name: void * fy_malloc_alloc(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,size_t size,size_t align)
methods.description: Allocates memory with specified size and alignment, assigns it a tag.

methods.name: void fy_malloc_free(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,void * data)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a specific tag.

methods.name: int fy_malloc_update_stats(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,struct fy_allocator_stats * stats)
methods.description: Updates statistical data about allocations for a given tag.

methods.name: const void * fy_malloc_storev(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,const struct iovec * iov,int iovcnt,size_t align)
methods.description: Stores multiple buffers concatenated, associated with a tag.

methods.name: const void * fy_malloc_store(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,const void * data,size_t size,size_t align)
methods.description: Stores a single buffer associated with a tag.

methods.name: void fy_malloc_release(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,const void * data,size_t size)
methods.description: Releases memory previously allocated with store functions, updating stats.

methods.name: void fy_malloc_release_tag(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag)
methods.description: Releases all entries associated with a specific tag and frees the tag.

methods.name: int fy_malloc_get_tag(struct fy_allocator * a)
methods.description: Allocates and returns a new tag ID.

methods.name: void fy_malloc_trim_tag(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag)
methods.description: No operation, placeholder for potential future implementation.

methods.name: void fy_malloc_reset_tag(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag)
methods.description: Resets all entries associated with a specific tag, freeing memory.

methods.name: struct:fy_allocator_info * fy_malloc_get_info(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag)
methods.description: Provides detailed information about current memory usage and tags.

methods.name: void * fy_malloc_tag_alloc(struct fy_malloc_allocator * ma,struct fy_malloc_tag * mt,size_t size,size_t align)
void fy_malloc_tag_free(struct fy_malloc_allocator * ma,struct fy_malloc_tag * mt,void * data)
